text: Midea Group Co., Ltd. is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (000333.SZ) and, since 17 September 2024, on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (0300.HK). Its ultimate holding company is Midea Holding Co., Ltd., which holds 28.33% of the shares and which the annual report lists as a domestic non-state-owned corporation; the ultimate controlling person is founder He Xiangjian, who is interested in approximately 94.55% of Midea Holding.

source.name: Midea Group Co., Ltd.: Annual Report 2024 (English version)
source.quote: The Company's ultimate holding company is Midea Holding Co., Ltd., and the ultimate controlling person is Mr. He Xiangjian.
